title: Kauai Foil Experience

services.name: Efoil Lessons
services.desc: Whether you are a complete beginner or an experienced thrill seeker get ready to have the time of you life as you "fly" over the water. Duration 1.5 hours About We begin each lesson with a safety briefing, demonstration on how to properly use the board. Our step by step process allows you to learn how to achieve sustained controlled flight during the first lesson. Please Note For safety precautions, we only allow 3 efoils out at a time. For groups of 4, there will be back-to-back lessons of groups of 2. Each lesson will still be 1.5 hours, 3 hours total for both
